title: TaskDispatch
description: Schema for a task dispatched to a multi-agent worker (hermes/grok/claude).

target_agent.description: Agent the task is routed to.

prompt.description: Prompt/instructions sent to the target agent.

max_turns.description: Maximum number of conversational turns allowed for the task.

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum spend allowed for the task, in USD.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.
